ex.en: My grandfather is very old.
ex.zh: 我爺爺年紀很大了。

ex.en: The old man lives alone.
ex.zh: 那位老先生一個人住。

old.en: having lived for a long time

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近碰到一位老朋友。

ex.en: I sold my old car.
ex.zh: 我把舊車賣了。

old.en: having existed for a long time, or known for a long time

ex.en: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你還沒到考駕照的年紀。

ex.en: His older brother is two years older than I.
ex.zh: 他哥哥比我大兩歲。

ex.en: I'm the second oldest of three children.
ex.zh: 我是三個孩子中的老二。

old.en: having a stated age, or being of an older age

ex.en: Peterhouse is the oldest of the 33 colleges of Cambridge.
ex.zh: 彼得學院是劍橋三十三個學院中最古老的。

ex.en: This is the oldest temple in Tainan.
ex.zh: 這是台南最古老的廟。

ex.en: She dreams of winning an Olympic gold medal one day.
ex.zh: 她夢想有一天能贏得奧運金牌。

ex.en: Many people stayed up late to watch the Olympic opening ceremony.
ex.zh: 很多人熬夜觀看奧運開幕典禮。

ex.en: Oliver loves playing with his toy trains.
ex.zh: 奧利佛愛玩他的玩具火車。

ex.en: Oliver helped his mother carry the groceries.
ex.zh: 奧利佛幫媽媽提雜貨。

ex.en: The Olympics are held every four years.
ex.zh: 奧林匹克運動會每四年舉行一次。

ex.en: Many young athletes dream of competing in the Olympics.
ex.zh: 許多年輕運動員夢想參加奧運。

ex.en: We stayed up late to watch the opening of the Olympics.
ex.zh: 我們熬夜看奧運開幕式。

ex.en: She added a few olives to the salad.
ex.zh: 她在沙拉裡加了幾顆橄欖。

ex.en: Olive oil is common in Mediterranean cooking.
ex.zh: 橄欖油在地中海料理中很常見。

ex.en: An olive tree can live for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 橄欖樹可以活上好幾百年。

ex.en: He wore an olive jacket on the camping trip.
ex.zh: 他在露營旅行時穿了一件橄欖綠的外套。

ex.en: The room's olive walls felt calm and warm.
ex.zh: 房間裡橄欖色的牆壁讓人覺得平靜又溫暖。

olympia.zh: 奧林匹亞（古希臘的聖地）

ex.en: Olympia in Greece is where the ancient Olympic Games were held.
ex.zh: 希臘的奧林匹亞是古代奧運舉辦的地方。

ex.en: The Olympic flame is lit in Olympia before each Games.
ex.zh: 每屆奧運開始前，聖火都會在奧林匹亞點燃。

olympian.zh: 威嚴超然的；奧林匹斯山的

ex.en: The judge spoke with Olympian calm.
ex.zh: 法官以超然的冷靜說話。

ex.en: Greek myths describe the Olympian gods living on a mountain.
ex.zh: 希臘神話描述奧林匹斯諸神住在山上。

ex.en: The Olympian trained for years before winning a medal.
ex.zh: 這位奧運選手訓練多年才拿到獎牌。

ex.en: Several Olympians visited our school last week.
ex.zh: 上週有幾位奧運選手來我們學校拜訪。

ex.en: Dogs have a much stronger olfactory sense than humans do.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺比人類靈敏得多。

ex.en: The olfactory nerve sends smell signals to the brain.
ex.zh: 嗅神經把氣味訊號傳到大腦。
